text: Personal data shall be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed.

In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the breach to the competent supervisory authority.
The processor shall not engage another processor without prior specific or general written authorisation of the controller.

A party terminating a continuing commercial agreement shall provide the other party with reasonable advance notice proportionate to the duration and nature of the relationship, absent an express contractual term to the contrary.
Any contractual clause limiting a supplier's liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence shall be considered void and unenforceable.

Where interest for late payment becomes payable, the rate of interest applied shall be the reference rate plus at least eight percentage points, unless otherwise agreed and not grossly unfair to the creditor.

Obligations of confidentiality relating to trade secrets shall continue to apply for as long as the information in question qualifies as a trade secret, and are not automatically extinguished upon termination of the underlying agreement.

For contracts of sale, any lack of conformity which becomes apparent within a minimum guarantee period set by national law shall be presumed to have existed at the time of delivery, unless this presumption is incompatible with the nature of the goods.
